description: This PHP source file defines a class 'HTTP_Session_Container_Memcache' that implements session handling using a Memcache database. It includes methods for connecting, reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting session data, with configuration options like memcache object and key prefix.

classes.name: HTTP_Session_Container_Memcache
classes.description: A class implementing session storage using Memcache, with methods for managing session data such as open, close, read, write, destroy, and garbage collection.

methods.name: HTTP_Session_Container_Memcache
methods.description: Constructor that sets default options and parses provided options.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to a Memcache object, validates the object.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration options for the container.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the session by establishing connection to the memcache.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session, here it simply returns true.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from Memcache using session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to Memcache with an expiration based on gc_maxlifetime.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data from Memcache by session ID.
